dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: How about I take a picture for you?

dialogues.speaker: Chasca
dialogues.text: I was thinking of giving something like this to my "mom," but knowing her, she'd probably just raise her wings and give me a tongue-lashing for not visiting her more often instead...

dialogues.speaker: Chasca
dialogues.text: So, I think I'll just hold onto this as a memento for myself.
